stories.title: Eagles' Saquon Barkley ruled out; DeVonta Smith to return
stories.summary: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers with a hamstring injury, but it appears WR DeVonta Smith will return.
stories.detail: PHILADELPHIA -- Eagles running back Saquon Barkley has been ruled out for Sunday's home game against the Carolina Panthers with a hamstring injury, but it appears receiver DeVonta Smith will make his return to the lineup. Smith does not carry an injury designation after missing the previous two games with a hamstring injury. "I'm good," Smith said when asked about the injury after practice Friday, adding that whether he plays is "up to the doctors." With Barkley, Will Shipley and Tank Bigsby all ruled out, Dameon Pierce is in line to get the bulk of the carries out of the backfield. Barkley exited early in the first quarter of the Week 4 loss to the Los Angeles Rams and has been sidelined since. Shipley was placed on injured reserve Friday with a foot injury, joining Bigsby (abdomen). Tanner McKee , meanwhile, is slated to start in place of quarterback Jalen Hurts , who was ruled out Thursday due to a superficial blood clot in his calf. Edge rusher Jonathan Greenard said he plans to test his ankle pregame, as he did in London before being ruled out against the Jaguars , though he carries no designation. Fellow edge rushers Jalyx Hunt (knee/ankle) and AJ Epenesa (back) and safety M…

stories.title: Packers' Josh Jacobs eligible to return next week amid probe
stories.summary: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will be removed from the commissioner exempt list Monday, the league announced, making him eligible to practice and play next week.
stories.detail: GREEN BAY, Wis. -- Packers running back Josh Jacobs will be removed from the commissioner exempt list Monday, the league announced, making him eligible to practice and play next week. The league's investigation into Jacobs under the personal conduct policy remains ongoing, however, leaving open the possibility that he could still be suspended. When he comes off the list next week, Jacobs will have missed the first six games of the season, and those games would count toward any suspension. However, if Jacobs ends up getting suspended for more than six games, he would have to miss additional games to make up the difference. After playing the Cowboys this Sunday at Lambeau Field, the Packers will visit the Lions on Oct. 25. "Josh has dedicated the last several months to bettering himself, and he accepts responsibility for his actions," Jacobs' attorneys, Clarence F. Duchac III, David Z. Chesnoff and Richard A. Schonfeld, said in a statement. "He is excited to get back to work and on the field with his teammates. Josh is grateful for the support he is receiving from his teammates, coaches, the Packers organization, and the greatest fans in the world." Jacobs was placed on the commissi…

stories.title: Trent McDuffie, Kam Curl questionable for Rams-Cardinals
stories.summary: Two of the Rams defensive backs are uncertain to play Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
stories.detail: Two of the Rams defensive backs are uncertain to play Sunday's game against the Cardinals. Trent McDuffie (groin) and safety Kam Curl (ankle) are both listed as questionable. Head coach Sean McVay told reporters that Trent McDuffie felt something in his groin at the end of Thursday’s session, so the team held him out of Friday’s practice out of an abundance of caution. McDuffie has registered seven passes defensed and an interception so far in 2026. The rest of the Rams are good to go, including tight end Davis Allen (foot) who missed the first two days of the practice week. He was limited in Friday’s session. Receiver/returner Alex Bachman (wrist), linebacker Nate Landman (wrist/shoulder), tight end Colby Parkinson (shoulder), linebacker Omar Speights (knee), offensive lineman Keagan Trost (hamstring), and cornerback Josh Wallace (shoulder) are the other players who are off the injury report.

stories.title: Decked-out, diehard Jaguars fans swarm London for pub takeover
stories.summary: Jaguars fans roll deep in the United Kingdom, and the fandom showed up big at London's briefly renamed ''Tealwood'' pub Thursday night.
stories.detail: LONDON -- For three hours Thursday night, the Greenwood sports pub and kitchen on Victoria Street in Central London ceased to exist. In its place: Tealwood. An apt renaming, as Greenwood was hosting one of three pub takeover events sponsored by the Jacksonville Jaguars ' U.K. branch for Jaguars fans who live in the United Kingdom or made the trip to London for the team's annual home game at Wembley Stadium this Sunday. There will be another Friday night and Saturday afternoon, and there was one the previous Friday night in advance of the Jaguars' home game at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium last week, which they won 19-17 on Cam Little 's 57-yard field goal as time expired. Those events are part of the NFL franchise's movement to continue to build its international fanbase, a push that began back in 2013 when the team played the first of what is now 15 games in London. The Jaguars also have their own U.K. fan club (Union Jax), have been heavily involved in helping to build interest in flag football with clinics, have appearances with current and former players throughout the year, run a year-round junior cheerleading program and send hundreds of students annually to the London games as …

stories.title: Bears' Caleb Williams questionable after 3 days of practice
stories.summary: The quarterback said there are several hurdles to clear before he would be able to face the Falcons on Sunday.
stories.detail: LAKE FOREST, Ill. -- Quarterback Caleb Williams was officially listed as questionable on the Chicago Bears ' final injury report ahead of their Week 6 game at the Atlanta Falcons ( Sunday, 1 p.m. ET, Fox ). Williams was a full participant during the Bears' Wednesday walk-through and practice sessions Thursday and Friday. The quarterback said he had to go through "a bunch of medical protocols" before being cleared by team trainers, which could happen before the team leaves for Atlanta. "I'm hopeful we'll have more clarity at the end of the day today," Bears coach Ben Johnson said Friday. "He looked good [Thursday] for one practice, but we've got to be able to stack a few back-to-back. He got some good work in on Wednesday, even though we walked through, he went through his own throwing session beforehand. Part of the plan, and he's on track right now." Williams missed three straight games while recovering from a hamstring injury sustained during the fourth quarter of a Week 2 loss to the Minnesota Vikings . teamStories.detail: (Photo by Steph Chambers/Getty Images) | Getty Images There are no surprises on the Las Vegas Raiders’ injury front as they head into Sunday’s home game against the Buffalo Bills. All of the injury details relayed by head coach Klint Kubiak Friday was expected. Starting defensive tackle Tonka Hemingway will not play. He missed all week of practice with a concussion he suffered last week at New England. Hemingway could have a chance to return next week. Hemingway has been the Raiders’ snap leader in the defensive tackle rotation. Expect Adam Butler, who is a team captain this week, and Jonah Laulu to get more playing time with Hemingway out against the Bills’ potent offense. Meanwhile, starting wide receiver Jalen Nailor will play after missing last week’s game with a concussion. Backup rookie offensive lineman Trey Zuhn is questionable with a knee injury that kept him out last week. Kubiak said neither wide receiver Dont’e Thornton nor tight end Carter Runyon will be activated from the injured reserve this week.

stories.detail: Did Jimmy Butler let the Golden State Warriors down when he tore his right ACL in January ? That seems like an awfully harsh assessment, but the veteran scorer feels that his injury prevented him from fulfiling expectations, something he's eager to amend. Going into his 16th NBA season, Butler is determined to justify the faith the Warriors showed in trading for him during the 2024-25 season . Join or create a Yahoo Fantasy Basketball league for the 2026-27 NBA season Without Butler, Golden State went 12-26 for the remainder of the season and barely qualified for the posteason as the No. 10 seed in the Western Conference. That got the Warriors into the Play-In Tournament , where they defeated the Los Angeles Clippers before getting eliminated by the Phoenix Suns in a blowout loss . "I really felt like I let Steph [Curry] down," Butler told ESPN's Anthony Slater . "I let Draymond [Green] down. I let Steve [Kerr] down. Because they took a chance." "If you don't know me and you haven't been around me, you don't know what I'm about because of the things that you may read and hear," he continued. stories.title: Rockets Amen Thompson named best perimeter defender by NBA GMs
stories.summary: High praise for Amen from GMs.
stories.detail: Every year, the NBA General Managers take a survey voting on certain topics such as best defender, player most likely to have a breakout season, best assistant coach, etc. What keeps this survey honest is that general managers are not allowed to vote for any of their players or staff. If you want to read the survey for yourself, you can do so here . This year, one particular Rocket was mentioned repeatedly in the survey, and that is Wing Amen Thompson, who scored second for most likely to break out, scored fourth for what player can move the ball fastest, and second for most adaptable defender (behind only Wembanyama), amongst other awards. Amen Thompson scored first in two categories, those being best perimeter defender and most athletic. For best perimeter defender, Thompson garnered 30% of the vote, surpassing both his twin brother Ausar Thompson and Alex Caruso, who both received 17%. In the athletic category, he was even more dominant, winning 63% of the vote, far more than Anthony Edwards, who came in second with 20%. stories.title: Bucks make way for Brewers’ World Series return with schedule change
stories.summary: The Bucks moved its home opener against the Bulls to avoid a conflict with the Brewers’ long-awaited World Series return.
stories.detail: The Milwaukee Brewers are making history , and the city’s NBA franchise doesn’t want to impede that in any way. The Bucks and NBA announced Friday, Oct. 16 that the team’s home opener against the Chicago Bulls has been moved up four hours to prevent a scheduling conflict with Game 1 of the World Series on Friday, Oct. 23, which will take place in Milwaukee and mark the club’s first trip to the Fall Classic in more than four decades . "The Brewers' return to the World Series for the first time in 44 years is a special moment for Milwaukee and sports fans across Wisconsin," the Bucks said Friday in a statement . "Congratulations to the Brewers and the entire organization on this tremendous achievement, and we’ll be cheering them on as they begin their World Series run. The Bucks are proud to move our home opener to 3 p.m. (CT), in recognition of this historic occasion and thank the NBA for making this schedule change possible." The Brewers clinched the National League pennant Thursday, Oct. 15 with their sweep of the Los Angeles Dodgers. They will face the winner of the American League Championship Series between the Cleveland Guardians and Tampa Bay Rays. Cleveland leads that serie…
